fact: Anecdotal estimates say only about 10% of South Sudan's roughly 12 million people hold Nationality Certificates (about 1.2 million, share as stated), and the country has yet to issue National ID cards at scale, per Hold the Child.
source_slug: 2025-12-15 Strengthening Civil Registration and Ending Statelessness in South Sudan

fact: The Sudan Independent, citing a July World Bank report, says nearly 90% of South Sudan's population lacked government-recognised identification of any kind, so about 10% hold one (below the 12.2 million population share of a third).
